text: 11月12日，外交部发言人毛宁主持例行记者会。法新社记者提问，据报道，中国的西北工业大学购买了英伟达H200芯片，而这不符合美国对华的出口限制。请问外交部对此有何评论？毛宁表示，你提到的具体情况，我不了解。中方在美国输华芯片问题上的立场是一贯的。同时，我们坚决反对美方泛化国家安全概念、划设各种名目的歧视性清单无理打压中国机构。（上观新闻）
text_en: On November 12, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning hosted a regular press conference. An AFP reporter asked: according to reports, China's Northwestern Polytechnical University purchased Nvidia H200 chips, which does not comply with US export restrictions on China. What is the Foreign Ministry's comment? Mao Ning said: I am not aware of the specific situation you mentioned. China's position on the issue of US chip exports to China is consistent. At the same time, we firmly oppose the US side's generalization of the national security concept, drawing up various discriminatory lists under various pretexts, and unreasonably suppressing Chinese institutions. (Shangguan News)
